name: ptyper3-bisect-b650
description: Which of the first commits of the parallel typer spike costs the serial compiler (no flag): `ptyper3-bisect-serial` measured `b650049602` about 8% slower than `2.13.x` on re2s through the typer. Its source changes on top of retronym/scala#212 are three commits (and a small fourth): every build paired within each fork, re2s stopped after the typer.

variantDescriptions.c93ab: `93ab666d7f` Run completions under one lock in a concurrent compiler
variantDescriptions.ce5c7: `e5c7ce2839` Add -Yparallel-typer, typing units on several threads
variantDescriptions.c2d3c: `2d3c8f9408` Confine or lock more state that the typer threads share
